recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If future review identifies defects in patient-knownNonDuplicate, make those corrections in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than changing core LinkType terminology for this issue.
issue_request: The Applied Jira asked to support known non-duplicate patient/person records. Although the original request proposed adding an is-not code to the LinkType value set, the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution required a standard Patient-context known-non-duplicates extension with 0..* Reference(Patient | RelatedPerson) values and definition text for manually affirmed non-duplicates.
initial_application: No core source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17501 was found. Core LinkType CodeSystem/ValueSet source remains unchanged without an is-not code, while the FHIR Extension Pack commit 27dd0e4 created StructureDefinition/patient-knownNonDuplicate; later extension-pack commits assigned its OID and marked it active. Core source/oids.ini contains the canonical OID registry entry for that extension URL.
additional_context: FHIR-16310 was the earlier same request resolved No Change as out of scope for the normative ballot and cloned into FHIR-17501. PA minutes show the WG first considered a LinkType code, then moved to a modified solution, and finally recorded a 5-0-0 persuasive-with-mod vote on 2023-03-29. The current core fhir.ini has the Patient resource active but no active profile entry for patient-knownNonDuplicate because the extension is maintained in the Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source edit was made because the final issue decision is already represented by the Extension Pack extension, and adding a core LinkType is-not code would contradict the modified resolution.
